title: Included Services and Add-On Fee Schedule, Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement
content:
The nightly rate of each Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement stay type includes a set of services; anything beyond them is billed from the price list below. The first table shows what each stay type includes, the second the prices of the add-ons and fees.

## What the nightly rate includes

| Stay type | Meals per day included | Medication administration by staff included | Medical appointment round trips included per stay | Personal laundry included | Incontinence supplies included |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Independent Living Trial Stay | 1 | No | 0 | No | No |
| Assisted Living Respite Stay (Standard Care) | 3 | Yes | 1 | Yes | No |
| Assisted Living Respite Stay (Enhanced Care) | 3 | Yes | 1 | Yes | Yes |
| Assisted Living Respite Stay (Extensive Care) | 3 | Yes | 1 | Yes | Yes |
| Memory Care Respite Stay | 3 | Yes | 0 | Yes | Yes |
| Post-Hospital Recovery Stay | 3 | Yes | 2 | Yes | Yes |

## Price list of add-ons and fees (USD)

| Stay type | Medication setup fee (per stay) | Visitor's meal (per meal) | Meal tray not ordered by the nurse (per tray) | Appointment round trip beyond those included (per trip) | Laundry (per load, where not included) | Incontinence supplies (per day, where not included) | One-to-one companion care (per hour) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Independent Living Trial Stay | 0.00 | 13.50 | 8.00 | 42.00 | 9.50 | 9.75 | 34.00 |
| Assisted Living Respite Stay (Standard Care) | 85.00 | 13.50 | 8.00 | 42.00 | 9.50 | 9.75 | 34.00 |
| Assisted Living Respite Stay (Enhanced Care) | 85.00 | 13.50 | 8.00 | 42.00 | 9.50 | 9.75 | 34.00 |
| Assisted Living Respite Stay (Extensive Care) | 85.00 | 13.50 | 8.00 | 42.00 | 9.50 | 9.75 | 34.00 |
| Memory Care Respite Stay | 85.00 | 13.50 | 8.00 | 42.00 | 9.50 | 9.75 | 34.00 |
| Post-Hospital Recovery Stay | 85.00 | 13.50 | 8.00 | 42.00 | 9.50 | 9.75 | 34.00 |

## Departure and key charges

| Stay type | Check-out time on the departure date (local time) | Late check-out fee (USD) | Lost key or fob (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Independent Living Trial Stay | 11:00 | 65.00 | 25.00 |
| Assisted Living Respite Stay (Standard Care) | 11:00 | 65.00 | 25.00 |
| Assisted Living Respite Stay (Enhanced Care) | 11:00 | 65.00 | 25.00 |
| Assisted Living Respite Stay (Extensive Care) | 11:00 | 65.00 | 25.00 |
| Memory Care Respite Stay | 11:00 | 65.00 | 25.00 |
| Post-Hospital Recovery Stay | 11:00 | 65.00 | 25.00 |

## Notes to the schedule

- The **medication setup fee** is the one-time fee per stay for pharmacy packaging and the medication administration record setup. It is 0.00 on the Independent Living Trial Stay, whose rate does not include medication administration, and 85.00 on every other stay type.
- The **laundry** price applies where personal laundry is not included, which on this schedule is the Independent Living Trial Stay only; the **incontinence supplies** daily price applies where supplies are not included, which is the Independent Living Trial Stay and the Assisted Living Respite Stay (Standard Care).
- The **late check-out fee** is the fee for checking out after the check-out time of 11:00 on the departure date.
- The **lost key** price is the fee for a lost apartment key or fob.
